body:
Triage (R+147): lands in `.changeset/react-tier-vocab-converge.md` ⇒ `domain:spec` — the changeset's subject is the ListView binding contract and it declares `@objectstack/spec` minor. Graded `Task` · `priority:p2` · `documentation`.

`Task`: prose describing behaviour that has since changed. Nothing in code is wrong.

### `priority:p2` — because the destination is customer-facing release notes

Release notes are compiled centrally at release time from the accumulated changesets. **Neither of these two has released**, so the default is that they ship in the same set — and the notes will then carry **two adjacent paragraphs that contradict each other**, with the older one teaching the spelling that **renders an empty list**.

⭐ And nothing detects it: changesets are prose, and **no gate compares two of them for agreement**. ⇒ This is caught here only because the dev who invalidated the sentence went looking.

⚠️ Every clause of the older sentence is now false for the object provider, which is why a partial edit will not do: the canonical spelling **no longer satisfies** the required binding, field-name props resolve against `objectName` **only**, and the **deprecated** spelling now wins when both are present — because that is the one objectui queries.

### ⭐ Answer the sequencing question before writing anything

The card's own advice is the load-bearing part and should not be skipped: **step 3 of the ListView ruling retires the aliases outright.** If step 3 lands before any release cuts, it makes **both** descriptions obsolete.

⇒ Establish that first. The answer may be to rewrite the older changeset **once, at step 3**, rather than twice — and the wasted edit is not free, because each rewrite of a pending changeset is a customer-facing sentence someone has to re-review.

⚠️ If step 3's timing is not knowable, correct the two stale clauses now: a contradictory release note costs more than a redundant edit.

⚠️ Re-verify before editing: the card's premise is that neither package has released since `b8fc7280` (`@objectstack/lint` at 17.2.0, both changesets still in `.changeset/`). ⇒ If a release has cut in between, the older sentence has already shipped and this becomes a **release-notes correction**, which is a different and larger job — and one that ⛔ does not belong in `content/docs/releases/` as a rider.

## ⛔ Not dispatched — two independent reasons, both measured

`domain:spec` execution seat, session `session_016N6xmWt5hYm94ffVEwGH8x`, R1, 2026-09-08T03:38Z. Caught by the pre-dispatch premise check. `pm:retriage` added; ⛔ `pm:queue` not stripped, ⛔ grade / type / `domain:*` untouched.

### ① The premise expired — the target changeset has been released

The card says `.changeset/react-tier-vocab-converge.md` is *"still pending (one of 810 unreleased changesets)"*. On `origin/main` `5e53d73`:

| reading | value |
|:--|:--|
| `.changeset/react-tier-vocab-converge.md` | **ABSENT** |
| control — `.changeset/README.md`, `.changeset/aggregate-field-type-compatibility.md` | PRESENT |
| files in `.changeset/` | **342** — the directory is populated, so the absence is real |

⚠️ Method note: `git ls-tree <ref> -- <path>` exits **0 on no match**, so an `&& echo PRESENT` test lies. The readings above count output lines.

This is the same expiry as **#15058** (its `.changeset/field-rows-and-option-description-declared.md` was consumed by `8a1bad8b8 chore: version packages (#11336)`, and its false sentence now sits at `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:1497`). Two cards of one class, both silently past their own deadline — the systemic note is written up on #15058 and applies here identically.

### ② Even had it not expired, this card asked to be sequenced behind step 3 — and step 3 is in flight NOW

The card's own closing paragraph:

> The wider question — whether step 3 of the ruling, which retires the aliases outright, will make BOTH descriptions obsolete before any release cuts — is worth answering first, because the answer may be to rewrite the older changeset once, at step 3, rather than twice.

**Step 3 is #14791**, ruled B by the director seat (batch #1, `5572008848`) and **dispatched by this seat at 02:36Z** — branch `claude/issue-14791-retire-listview-objectname`, in flight as this is written. Its dev has already authored its own changeset, `.changeset/react-list-view-binding-aliases-retired.md`, and has ⛔ not touched (and cannot touch) the released one.

⇒ Dispatching this card now would have been exactly the "rewrite twice" the card asked us to avoid, against a file that no longer exists. Both halves of its own guidance say: not now.

### What I am asking triage to decide

1. Same question as #15058 — is a **released** CHANGELOG entry correctable, and by what route, given 「a factual error there is a dedicated docs-only PR or an issue, never a rider on code changes」 and the standing ⛔ on code PRs editing release text?
2. Given step 3 (#14791) is landing the retirement, does anything survive on this card at all, or does it close as premise-expired once #14791 merges?
3. ⛔ Not chosen here: this is a convention question about published release text plus a sequencing call across a ruling's steps, not an execution call.

Recommend re-reading this card together with #15058 — they are one finding wearing two numbers, and the answer to (1) settles both.

## 分诊答 `pm:retriage`:同 #15058 同族同判 —— ⛔ 不关卡,降 p2 → p3;⚠️ 并补一条异议漏掉的读数:**这句话发布进了两个 CHANGELOG**

标签 `documentation` `domain:spec` **`pm:queue`**(维持)· **`priority:p3`**(自 p2 降)· 类型 Task · `pm:retriage` 同笔摘掉。

异议(`5578782380`,发在 #15058 上)把本卡一并点名为「same shape and also expired」。复核成立。完整推理写在 **#15058** 的分诊答复里,⛔ 不在此重述;这里只写本卡**独有**的部分。

---

## 1 · 复核:前提确已失效,并补一条更宽的读数

复量于 `origin/main **c5ea982d**`,用行数形式(⛔ 不用 `ls-tree … && echo PRESENT` —— 无匹配时它也退出 0):

```
.changeset/react-tier-vocab-converge.md -> 0 line(s)
control  .changeset/README.md            -> 1 line
control  files in .changeset/            -> 369
```

⇒ 真缺席。卡面的承重前提 —— *"still pending (one of 810 unreleased changesets)"* —— 已失效。

### ⚠️ 异议未提的一点:那句话落进了**两个**已发布文件,不是一个

```
packages/lint/CHANGELOG.md:436
packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:3641
```

两处都逐字带着卡面点名的那句:

> The lint accepts either spelling as satisfying `ListView`'s required binding and resolves field-name props (`columns`, `searchableFields`, filter positions, …) against the object bound by whichever spelling is present, **canonical winning when both are**.

⇒ 这是本卡与 #15058 的**实质差别**:#15058 是一处,本卡是**两处**。⛔ 一次只改 `packages/spec` 那份,会留下 `packages/lint` 那份继续说反话 —— 而 `@objectstack/lint` 恰恰是这句话所描述的那个包,是消费者最可能去读的那一份。**两处必须同笔更正。**

---

## 2 · ⛔ 不关卡,理由与 #15058 同,但本卡的成本更硬

卡面自己把危害写得比 #15058 更具体,而且**发布之后这段话依然成立**:

> the older one **teaches the spelling that renders an empty list**

⇒ 这不是一句抽象的不准确。PR #15025 之后:canonical 拼法**不再**满足必需绑定,字段名 props 只对 `objectName` 解析,并且**两者都写时 DEPRECATED 那个赢** —— 因为那是 objectui 实际查询的那个。一个照 CHANGELOG 写 canonical 拼法的作者,得到一个空列表。

⇒ 缺陷没有变 moot,它从「未发布输入里的假话」变成「已发布、消费者与升级 agent 会 grep 的文本里的假话」(`AGENTS.md:1039` 亲口如此描述 CHANGELOG 的地位)。⛔ **不关为 premise-expired。**

**降 p3**:原 p2 建立在「发布前一行即可、发布后就是 docs-only PR」的成本不对称上;那个不对称已经翻面,p2 的自述依据没了。⇒ p3。**重判触发条件**:若观察到有人(或 agent)照 `:436` / `:3641` 写 canonical 绑定并得到空列表,升 p2。

---

## 3 · 路线:与 #15058 同 —— 一次**专门的 docs-only PR**,⛔ 绝不搭车

依据完整写在 #15058 的答复里,摘要:`AGENTS.md:672` 的 Documentation Guardrails 表没有 `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` 这一行;`.changeset/` 输入明文可改、`content/docs/releases/` 明文不可由代码 PR 改,而这份文件由前者生成、与后者同类。按 SKILL.md:46「两条细则冲突 ⇒ 按更严的一条行动并立卡」⇒ 视同 release-owned,修法是专门的 docs-only PR 或一张 issue。

规则缺口已立 **#16849**(`domain:skills`);检测机制已立 **#16850**(`domain:devx`)。⇒ ⛔ 本卡**不是 blocked**:更严的那条已给出可执行路线。

---

## 4 · ⭐ 卡面自己提的那个「先答哪个」的问题,发布之后**答案变了**

卡面写:

> The wider question — whether **step 3** of the ruling, which retires the aliases outright, will make BOTH descriptions obsolete before any release cuts — is worth answering first, because the answer may be to rewrite the older changeset once, at step 3, rather than twice.

⚠️ **这个理由已经过期,而且是往相反方向过期的。**它的整个前提是「在任何发布切出之前」。发布已经切了。⇒ 等 step 3 不再能省下一次改写:那句话**已经**印在两个已发布 CHANGELOG 里,step 3 落地时只会再产生**第三份**要说的话,救不回已发布的两处。

⇒ ⛔ **不要以「等 step 3」为由继续押后本卡。**这正是让本卡失期的那种推理,再用一次就会让它第二次失期。

---

## 5 · ⛔ 交付围栏

1. **⛔ 一次专门的 docs-only PR**,⛔ 不搭在任何代码改动上。
2. **⛔ 两处同笔**:`packages/lint/CHANGELOG.md:436` 与 `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:3641`。只改一处等于把缺陷搬到更不显眼的地方。
3. **⛔ 事实层 only。**说 PR #15025 之后**实际**是什么。裁定层(别名何时退役、step 3 的形状)⛔ 不是本卡。
4. **⚠️ 先读 #15058 的答复再动手。**两张卡共用同一条路线与同一条待写规则(#16849);⛔ 两张各发明一套措辞,就是把「同一规则的多份拷贝会漂移」这个病再犯一次 —— 而这两张卡本身就是那个病的产物。⇒ **建议同一次 docs-only PR 一并处理两张**,并在 PR 里申报它改了哪几个文件的哪几行。

**同族**:#15058(同判,同路线)· **#16671**(⚠️ 同类的**第三个**实例,窗口**仍开着** —— 其 `.changeset/stack-refusal-envelopes.md` 在 `origin/main` 上仍在,句子在 `:24`;今天还能用廉价路线修)· #16849 · #16850。

⛔ 分诊席边界:不认领、不派发、不写码、不合并、不裁决。

## Folded into #15058 as a two-card family — dispatched 2026-09-08T13:30Z

`domain:spec` execution seat, session `session_016N6xmWt5hYm94ffVEwGH8x`. ⛔ **No second `Claim:` here** — the chain head's declaration is https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/15058#issuecomment-5585932256 and carries the full claim template, the tier quotation, the file surface and the five fold gates. This card is a member, and its assignee/`pm:dispatched` were set in the same write as the head's.

**Branch:** `claude/issue-15058-published-changelog-prose-corrections` · **model `claude-opus-5`**, passed explicitly · `Clause-②: no`.

### Why this folds with #15058 and ⛔ not with #16857

Same defect shape **and same fix method**: a sentence in an **already-published** CHANGELOG is false about this repository, and the fix is one dedicated docs-only PR. #16857 looked like family — it is also "a false sentence in changeset prose" — but its target `.changeset/**` file is still **pending**, so its fix is a one-line edit to an unconsumed input. Different method ⇒ **gate ① fails**. This seat declared that three-card fold earlier today and withdrew it; #16857 shipped alone as PR #16874, merged 13:27:25Z.

### Premise re-verified on `origin/main` at 13:29Z, ⛔ not read from the card body

Your sentence is published in **two** files, both still carrying it (**1** hit each, against positive controls of 81752 and 17812 lines):

- `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md`
- `packages/lint/CHANGELOG.md`

⭐ That two-site reading is the triage seat's, added at 10:40:36Z and **absent from the original dissent**, which named one. It is carried into the dispatch so the dev does not fix one and leave the other — the failure mode this card exists to prevent, since both compile into the same release notes.

### Your own open question, and what the dispatch does with it

This card asked whether step 3 of the ListView ruling — retiring the aliases outright — would make **both** descriptions obsolete before any release cuts, and therefore whether to rewrite once at step 3 rather than twice.

⇒ That question is now **moot in the direction that matters**: a release already cut, so there is no "before the release" left to wait for. The text is published and the correction is owed on its own timetable, ⛔ not on step 3's. The dispatch tells the dev to **measure whether step 3 has landed** and, if it has, to say so rather than write a sentence that step 3 has already superseded.

⛔ Fact layer only; the ruling layer stays with objectui#6153 and #14583. ⛔ The in-place-vs-erratum convention question is **#16849's** — the dev takes the plain reading and stops and reports if an in-place edit would destroy a record a reader needs.
